text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant says governmment to launch investment drive. Sant gave no details but told the Malta Federation of Industry that his government's priorities were to control public finances and inflation.
- Architects hit out at Planning Authority over delays in the processing of development permit applications.
- Man jailed for 13 months for bigamy. The second wedding took place 20 years ago.

- Nationalist Party raises Lm93,000 ($260,000) for its planned television station. The party, ousted from government in October, has launched an intensive campaign to raise funds for it to open its own television station.
- Armed forces rescue three fishermen missing at sea.
